name: BetterPlay
description: Picks the best version and bitrate for each viewer's connection and keeps playback from freezing.
overview: Smart version selection, adaptive streaming and freeze prevention for every client.

versions.changelog: Probe v0.2 (watch only): session health from player request timing (works behind nginx buffering), segment length from playlists, Known proxies warning, server settings on the dashboard, unit tests.
Security fix: API keys inside transcode URLs were not removed from the probe log. Fixed, and existing log files are cleaned on startup. Update and restart.
Probe release (watch only): records how each app requests and plays video, never changes playback. Dashboard page with status, hook health, settings, recent playback and events, log downloads.
